nodeDefs.name: Starlight Affinity
nodeDefs.desc: +10% Lumen from every kill, per level.

nodeDefs.name: Echoing Rest
nodeDefs.desc: +5 percentage points offline earning rate per level, up to 100% before Projects (6 levels).

nodeDefs.name: Cheaper Bonds
nodeDefs.desc: −3% Wisp recruitment and Empower Lumen cost per level, down to 40% cost (20 levels).

nodeDefs.name: Swift Ascension
nodeDefs.desc: +4% Prisms earned per Ascend, per level.

nodeDefs.name: Eternal Momentum
nodeDefs.desc: +6% passive Wisp damage per level; also raises the Wisp-powered part of your tap damage.

nodeDefs.name: Deep Reserves
nodeDefs.desc: Retired offline extension. Previous purchases are refunded in Prisms.

models.legacy: All original prices/levels/bonuses unchanged when no new node is owned.
models.doubleSwiftBonus: Counterfactual doubles only the Swift contribution (+4%/level becomes +8%/level); old prices stay. Requires extending exact Prism arithmetic/oracles; not preferred.
models.softExponential110: Counterfactual owned price ceil(9976*(11/10)^(Swift-20)) for Swift>=20; remains exponential.
models.linearAfter20: Candidate owned price60+6*(Swift-20) for Swift>=20; otherwise original.
models.linearAfter10: Alternative owned price60+6*(Swift-10) for Swift>=10; otherwise original. Earlier threshold responds to actual mature fixture Swift6.
models.scope: Design-only numerical models. Existing production reward oracle remains unchanged; no model is installed.
